name: mdeditor-graphics-bundle
description: Builds wwwroot/lib/three/stl-viewer.min.js and wwwroot/lib/geo/geo.min.js for mdEditor

scripts.build: esbuild three-entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --legal-comments=eof --outfile=../../wwwroot/lib/three/stl-viewer.min.js && esbuild geo-entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --legal-comments=eof --outfile=../../wwwroot/lib/geo/geo.min.js && node copy-data.js
